GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider Jye McNeil explained he had no specific settling instructions but noted the gelding had led previously. As it is one paced, he was instructed to place the horse under pressure from the 1000m to build a winning break. He did so and improved past the field before straightening, but the gelding tired shortly after and finished only fairly. Trainer confirmed these instructions and felt the horse raced keenly throughout, which may have affected its performance. A post race veterinary examination revealed lameness in the near foreleg and off hind leg
